what: 1. User-defined area of interest and grid resolution
title: User-defined grid
text: Defining geographic extent analysis grid early ensures subsequent data extraction, aggregation, visualisation tasks carried within consistent spatial framework. vignette : Load national boundary South Africa set area interest (AoI). Select working resolution 0.5° (≈ 55 km) balance spatial detail computational cost. Convert AoI terra vector raster operations run efficiently. Create blank raster template using chosen resolution AoI’s CRS (Coordinate Reference System). Populate raster placeholder values (simply 1). Mask raster AoI cells whose centroids fall within South Africa remain.
code: # 1. Load the national boundary  # The shapefile is shipped with the package for full reproducibility. rsa = sf::st_read(system.file("extdata", "rsa.shp", package = "dissmapr")) #> Reading layer `rsa' from data source  #>   `/home/runner/.cache/R/renv/library/dissmapr-347017a9/linux-ubuntu-noble/R-4.6/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu/dissmapr/extdata/rsa.shp'  #>   using driver `ESRI Shapefile' #> Simple feature collection with 1 feature and 1 field #> Geometry type: POLYGON #> Dimension:     XY #> Bounding box:  xmin: 16.45802 ymin: -34.83514 xmax: 32.89125 ymax: -22.12661 #> Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84  # 2. Choose a working resolution  # A 0.5‑degree cell size strikes a balance between computational load and # the spatial resolution at which national‑level biodiversity patterns remain # interpretable. res = 0.5   # decimal degrees° (≈ 55 km at the equator)  # 3. Convert the AoI to a 'terra' vector  # 'terra' supports fast raster operations; converting now avoids repeated # coercion later. rsa_vect = terra::vect(rsa)  # 4. Initialise a blank raster template  # The template inherits the AoI’s coordinate reference system (CRS) and is # discretised into equally‑sized cells according to the resolution chosen. grid = terra::rast(rsa_vect, resolution = res, crs = terra::crs(rsa_vect))  # 5. Populate the raster with placeholder values  # We simply assign the value 1 to every cell; the values themselves are # irrelevant at this stage—the grid’s geometry is what matters. terra::values(grid) = 1  # 6. Clip the raster to the AoI  # Any cells whose centroids fall outside the boundary are set to NA, thereby # restricting subsequent computations to the AoI only. grid_masked = terra::mask(grid, rsa_vect) # grid_masked is now a 0.5° lattice clipped to South Africa and will serve as the common spatial denominator for all downstream summaries.

title: Map bioregions
text: step translate site‐level ζ₂ predictions spatial bioregions. Calling map_bioreg() predictors_df following: z-scales predicted turnover, longitude latitude; fits four clustering algorithms (k-means, PAM, hierarchical GMM); k-means partitions points around centroids fast large data sets. PAM (Partitioning Around Medoids) medoid-based analogue k-means robust outliers. Hierarchical agglomerative clustering builds dendrogram “cuts” chosen k, capturing nested structure data. GMM (Gaussian Mixture Model) treats clusters multivariate normal distributions assigns point maximum likelihood. realigns method’s labels k-means solution consistency; builds nearest-neighbour thin-plate-spline interpolated surfaces; returns raw cluster assignments gridded rasters, —show_plot=TRUE—draws 2×2 panel maps. result set complementary bioregion maps rasters can use compare different algorithms partition landscape based compositional turnover geography.

title: dissmapr 0.2.0
text: Aligned package B-Cubed software development guide; R CMD check now passes 0 errors, 0 warnings 0 notes. Rewrote README self-contained, runnable minimal example; moved nine tutorials pkgdown Articles added “Get started” vignette documentation compiles cleanly b3doc. Removed unused optimized_compute_orderwise() development duplicate leftover hello() template function. Documented exported-function arguments fixed example data every example runs; added real testthat test get_occurrence_data(). Trimmed ~11 MB unused bundled data (development caches workspace files). Now requires R (>= 4.1.0) (uses native pipe |>).
